correctness.rationale: The nilpotent Hall decomposition, identical attached-tree reduction, cycle optimization, and coprime order-spectrum formula are direct. The cyclic prime case follows from an explicit level matching argument. Exact dynamic programming independently agrees with the closed cyclic formula in 600 finite cases.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Power-map functional-graph structure is prior art and is not claimed. The inspected recent power-avoiding and functional-graph papers did not yield the exact nilpotent independence-number factorization or the closed cyclic prime formula. The uninspected full texts of Fernandes-Reis (2024) and McVeagh's 2026 thesis remain material residual risks.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact reduction for every finite nilpotent group and a closed formula for every cyclic group under prime powering, extending a new extremal group invariant well beyond the near-full-size cases emphasized in the source paper.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
